title: Divergence-Based Similarity Function for Multi-View Contrastive Learning
abstract: arXiv:2507.06560v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent success in contrastive learning has sparked growing interest in more effectively leveraging multiple augmented views of data. While prior methods incorporate multiple views at the loss or feature level, they primarily capture pairwise relationships and fail to model the joint structure across all views. In this work, we propose a divergence-based similarity function (DSF) that explicitly captures the joint structure by representing each set of augmented views as a distribution and measuring similarity as the divergence between distributions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSF consistently improves performance across diverse tasks, including kNN classification, linear evaluation, transfer learning, and distribution shift, while also achieving greater efficiency than other multi-view methods. translated_title: 基于散度的多视图对比学习相似度函数
translated_abstract: 对比学习的近期成功激发了人们更有效地利用数据多个增强视图的浓厚兴趣。虽然先前的方法在损失或特征层面融合多个视图，但它们主要捕捉成对关系，无法对所有视图之间的联合结构进行建模。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于散度的相似度函数（DSF），它通过将每组增强视图表示为一个分布，并将相似度测量为分布之间的散度，从而显式地捕捉联合结构。大量实验表明，DSF 在多种任务上持续提升性能，包括 kNN 分类、线性评估、迁移学习和分布偏移，同时比其他多视图方法具有更高的效率。此外，我们建立了 DSF 与余弦相似度之间的联系，并证明与余弦相似度不同，DS……
tldr: 本文提出基于散度的相似度函数（DSF），将多个增强视图建模为分布并以分布间散度衡量相似度，从而显式捕捉所有视图的联合结构，在多项任务上性能更优且效率更高。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a divergence-based similarity function (DSF) that represents augmented views as distributions and measures similarity via distributional divergence, explicitly capturing the joint structure across all views while achieving superior performance and efficiency on diverse tasks.
